questions.reflectionEn: Set your hope fully on the grace that is coming when He appears.
questions.reflectionAm: ክብሩ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ ተስፋህን በእርሱ ላይ አድርግ።

questions.questionEn: Are you awake to His coming?
questions.reflectionEn: Watchfulness is love, not fear, so stay alert in peace.
questions.reflectionAm: ንቃት ፍቅር እንጂ ፍርሃት አይደለም፤ በሰላም ንቁ ሁን።

questions.reflectionEn: Be ready, not anxious, because His coming is a homecoming.
questions.reflectionAm: ተዘጋጅ እንጂ አትጨነቅ፤ መምጣቱ ወደ ቤት መመለስ ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: He promised to return for you, so rest in the promise without fear.
questions.reflectionAm: ሊመልስህ ቃል ገብቷል፤ ያለ ፍርሃት በቃሉ ዕረፍ።

questions.questionEn: What will you be found doing?
questions.reflectionEn: Stay ready in the simple obedience of the day, for faithfulness prepares the heart.
questions.reflectionAm: የዕለቱን ታዛዥነት ቀጥል፤ ታማኝነት ልብን ያዘጋጃል።

questions.questionEn: Is your lamp trimmed and lit?
questions.reflectionEn: Keep watch in love, for readiness grows quietly in everyday habits.
questions.reflectionAm: በፍቅር ተጠብቅ፤ ዝግጁነት በዕለታዊ ልማድ በፀጥታ ያድጋል።

questions.questionEn: How will you greet His return?
questions.reflectionEn: Confidence at His coming grows from a friendship kept ordinary and daily.
questions.reflectionAm: በፊቱ በድፍረት መቆም በዕለታዊ ወዳጅነት ያድጋል።

questions.questionEn: Is your heart ready for Home?
questions.reflectionEn: Home is where He waits, and every quiet day prepares the way.
questions.reflectionAm: ቤት ያለበት እርሱ የሚጠብቅበት ነው፤ ጸጥ ያለ ቀን መንገድን ያዘጋጃል።

questions.questionEn: Who will stand with you then?
questions.reflectionEn: Purity is peace in His presence, and He is not ashamed of His own.
questions.reflectionAm: ንጽሕና በፊቱ ሰላም ነው፤ የራሱን አያፍርም።

questions.questionEn: Have you talked to Him today?
questions.reflectionEn: He inclines His ear, and no need is too small for Him.
questions.reflectionAm: ጆሮውን ያዘነብላል፤ ለእርሱ ምንም ነገር አይትንስም።

questions.questionAm: በልብህ ላይ ያለው ሸክም ምንድን ነው?
questions.reflectionEn: Pour out what you carry, for His care is wide enough for all of it.
questions.reflectionAm: የምትሸከመውን አፍስስ፤ እንክብካቤው ለሁሉም ይበቃል።

questions.reflectionEn: Persist with hope, for faithful prayer keeps the heart awake, not weary.
questions.reflectionAm: በተስፋ ቀጥል፤ ታማኝ ጸሎት ልብን ነቅቶ ያስቀምጣል እንጂ አያድክምም።

questions.reflectionEn: Come with boldness and awe, for mercy invites rather than intimidates.
questions.reflectionAm: በድፍረትና በመደነቅ ቅረብ፤ ምሕረት ይጋብዛል እንጂ አያስፈራም።

questions.questionEn: Is praise part of your prayer?
questions.reflectionEn: Worship before asking settles the heart in what is already true.
questions.reflectionAm: ከመጠየቅ በፊት ማምለክ ልብን በእውነት ያረጋዋል።

questions.reflectionEn: Joyful hope prays as it breathes, staying near from morning to evening.
questions.reflectionAm: የተስፋ ደስታ እንደ እስትንፋስ ይጸልያል፤ ከንጋት እስከ ማታ ቅርብ ነው።

questions.questionEn: What did the Word say today?
questions.reflectionEn: Scripture lights the path and plants endurance, all in order to carry hope.
questions.reflectionAm: ቃሉ መንገድን ያበራል፣ ጽናትን ይተክላል፣ ተስፋን ይሸከማል።

questions.reflectionEn: The Word is bread to be eaten and done, so hear it and obey.
questions.reflectionAm: ቃሉ የሚበላም የሚተገበርም ነው፤ ለመፈጸም ስማው።

questions.reflectionEn: Delight in it day and night; it revives the soul and clears the way.
questions.reflectionAm: በቀንና በሌሊት ውደድ፤ ነፍስን ያድሳል፣ መንገድን ያቀልላል።

questions.questionEn: Are His words abiding in you?
questions.reflectionEn: Hold to His word, for the truth that stays sets the heart free.
questions.reflectionAm: ቃሉን ያዝ፤ የቆየ እውነት ልብን ነጻ ያደርጋል።

questions.reflectionEn: Crave the Word like newborn milk, and hide it in the heart.
questions.reflectionAm: እንደ ወተት ቃሉን ተናፍቅ፤ መንገድን ለመጠበቅ በልብ ተደበቀ።

questions.questionEn: Why do you open the Book?
questions.reflectionEn: It testifies of Him rather than mere knowledge, so seek the life it speaks of.
questions.reflectionAm: ስለ እርሱ ይመሰክራል እንጂ ለእውቀት ብቻ አይደለም፤ የሚናገረውን ሕይወት ፈልግ።

questions.reflectionEn: Deep roots bear quiet fruit, and a life planted in Him grows unseen yet steady.
questions.reflectionAm: ጥልቅ ሥር ጸጥ ያለ ፍሬ ያፈራል፤ በእርሱ የተተከለ ሕይወት በስውር ግን በጽናት ያድጋል።

questions.reflectionEn: Day by day the mind renews, and growth makes you ready with a gentle answer.
questions.reflectionAm: አዕምሮው በየቀኑ ይታደሳል፤ እድገት ገር መልስ ተዘጋጅቶ እንድትሆን ያደርጋል።

questions.questionAm: ወደ እርሱ እየቀረብክ ነው ወይስ እየራቅክ?
questions.reflectionEn: Draw near and the nearness is mutual, for the soul that clings does not slip.
questions.reflectionAm: ቅረብ፣ ቅርበቱ የሁለት ነው፤ የተጣበቀች ነፍስ አይንሸራተትም።

questions.reflectionEn: Precious things are tested, and gold in the fire comes out more genuine.
questions.reflectionAm: ውድ ነገር ይፈተናል፤ ወርቅ በእሳት የበለጠ ትክክለኛ ሆኖ ይወጣል።

questions.questionEn: Thirsty for God or just busy?
questions.reflectionEn: The thirsting soul finds its home in Him, for apart from Him nothing truly grows.
questions.reflectionAm: የተናፈቀች ነፍስ ማረፊያዋን በእርሱ ታገኛለች፤ ያለ እርሱ የሚያድግ የለም።

questions.questionAm: መልካም አፈር ነህ ወይስ ደረቅ ምድር?
questions.reflectionEn: Noble hearts hold the word and keep it, and receptive soil bears manifold fruit.
questions.reflectionAm: ቃሉን የሚያዙ ልቦች ያፈራሉ፤ የተቀበለ አፈር ብዙ ፍሬ ያበቅላል።

questions.reflectionEn: Strength grows as the heart leans upward and is planted well in His courts.
questions.reflectionAm: ልብ ወደ ላይ ሲያዘነብልና በግቢው ሲተከል ጉልበቱ ያድጋል።

questions.questionAm: ፍሬ እያፈራህ ነው ወይስ ቅጠል ብቻ?
questions.reflectionEn: Fruit shows what the roots believe, and bearing continues long after if abiding does.
questions.reflectionAm: ፍሬ ሥር ያመነውን ያሳያል፤ ተጣብቀህ ካለህ ለረጅም ጊዜ ትፈራለህ።

questions.reflectionEn: A renewed mind begins by seeking one kingdom, and transformation follows the seeking.
questions.reflectionAm: የታደሰ አዕምሮ አንዲትን መንግሥት በመፈለግ ይጀምራል፤ ለውጥ ፍለጋውን ይከተላል።

questions.questionAm: ወደ ኋላ መመለስ ደህና ነው ይሰማሃል?
questions.reflectionEn: He is faithful to forgive, and the father runs, so the welcome is real.
questions.reflectionAm: ይቅር ለማለት ታማኝ ነው፤ አባት ይሮጣል፣ አቀባበሉ እውነተኛ ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: Buried sorrow becomes confessed mercy, and dropping the cover leaves no room for shame.
questions.reflectionAm: ከመሸፈን ይልቅ መናዘዝ ምሕረትን ያመጣል፤ ሽፋኑን መጣል ለሐፍረት ቦታ አይተውም።

questions.reflectionEn: Fruit proves the turn, and a clean heart is a created gift, not a resolution.
questions.reflectionAm: ፍሬ መመለስን ያረጋግጣል፤ የንጹህ ልብ ስጦታ እንጂ ውሳኔ አይደለም።

questions.reflectionEn: God stays near the broken, and walking in the light, His Son keeps washing sins.
questions.reflectionAm: እግዚአብሔር ከተሰበረ ጋር ቅርብ ነው፤ በብርሃን ሲሄዱ የልጁ ደም ያነጻል።

questions.reflectionEn: Regret looks back, but repentance turns and bears the fruit of a changed step.
questions.reflectionAm: ጸጸት ወደ ኋላ ይመለከታል፤ ንስሐ ያዞራልና የለውጥ ፍሬ ያፈራል።

questions.reflectionEn: Ask for a clean heart rather than a cover, and brokenness before Him becomes worship.
questions.reflectionAm: ሽፋን ሳይሆን ንጹህ ልብን ጠይቅ፤ በፊቱ መሰበር ወደ አምልኮ ይሆናል።

questions.reflectionEn: Loved first, you love, and the new command stays close to everyday faces.
questions.reflectionAm: ቀድሞ ተወድደህ ትወዳለህ፤ አዲሱ ትዕዛዝ ከዕለት ተዕለት ፊቶች ጋር ይቀርባል።

questions.reflectionEn: Love with actions and truth, not speech alone; sincere love hates nothing it can mend.
questions.reflectionAm: በቃል ብቻ ሳይሆን በተግባርና በእውነት ውደድ፤ ቅን ፍቅር ያልጠገነውን አይተውም።

questions.reflectionEn: Love your neighbor and even the enemy, for grace in the hard place is love.
questions.reflectionAm: ባልንጀራን ውደድ፣ ጠላትን እንኳን፤ በአስቸጋሪ ቦታ ጸጋ እውነተኛ ፍቅር ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: Love does no harm and covers offenses, and choosing peace does not lose the truth.
questions.reflectionAm: ፍቅር አይጎዳም፣ ጥፋትን ይሸፍናል፤ ሰላም መምረጥ እውነትን አያስጠፋም።

questions.reflectionEn: Sincere love detests the fake, and a purified heart loves one another deeply.
questions.reflectionAm: ቅን ፍቅር ግብዝነትን ይጠላል፤ የነጻ ልብ በጥልቀት ይወዳል።

questions.reflectionEn: Remain in His love to spill it; the love received becomes what you give.
questions.reflectionAm: በፍቅሩ ቆይ እንድታፈስ፤ የተቀበልከው ፍቅር የምትሰጠው ይሆናል።

questions.reflectionEn: Faith sees the unseen, and your gaze settles on the author who completes it.
questions.reflectionAm: እምነት የማይታየውን ያያል፤ ዓይንህ በሚያጠናቅቀው ጀማሪው ላይ ያርፋል።

questions.reflectionEn: Small faith under a great God moves what seems immovable; size is not the point.
questions.reflectionAm: ትንሽ እምነት በታላቅ እግዚአብሔር ሥር የማይነሳውን ያነሳል፤ መጠኑ ዋናው አይደለም።

questions.reflectionEn: Blessed are those who believe without seeing, and loving Him unseen is real faith.
questions.reflectionAm: ሳያዩ የሚያምኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፤ ሳታየው መውደድ እውነተኛ እምነት ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: Trust Him with the whole road, not just the map; fear fades when trust speaks.
questions.reflectionAm: መንገዱን ሙሉ አደራ ስጠው እንጂ ካርታውን ብቻ ሳይሆን፤ መታመን ሲናገር ስጋት ይጠፋል።

questions.questionEn: What do you do with fear?
questions.reflectionEn: Say honestly what you need, and help my unbelief is a faithful prayer.
questions.reflectionAm: የሚፈልጉትን በቅንነት ተናገር፤ የእምነት ማጣቴን እርዳኝ ታማኝ ጸሎት ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: Still believe you will see His goodness; have faith in God, not in fear.
questions.reflectionAm: በርኅራኄው እንደምታይ እመን፤ በፍርሃት ሳይሆን በእግዚአብሔር እመን።

questions.reflectionEn: Following Him is walked daily, one quiet step of trust at a time.
questions.reflectionAm: መከተል በየቀኑ ከእርሱ ጋር በእርጋታ መራመድ ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: He calls you to follow, not just come near; the way is walked beside Him.
questions.reflectionAm: ቅርብ እንድትሆን ሳይሆን እንድትከተል ይጠራሃል፤ መንገዱ ከእርሱ ጋር ይራመዳል።

questions.reflectionEn: He makes fishers of people, and following Him means serving where He serves.
questions.reflectionAm: የሰዎች አጥማጆች ያደርጋል፤ እርሱ በሚያገለግልበት መሆን መከተል ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: Make disciples as you walk with Him; faith is seen in the doing.
questions.reflectionAm: ከእርሱ ጋር ስትሄድ ደቀ መዝሙር ፍጠር፤ ማስተማር ይታያል፣ እምነት በተግባር ይሰማል።

questions.questionEn: What is the cross you carry?
questions.reflectionEn: The follower counts what it costs, and the cross is the shape love takes daily.
questions.reflectionAm: ተከታዩ ዋጋውን ይቆጥራል፤ ቍርባን የዕለት ፍቅር ቅርጽ ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: Where He leads His followers go, and His example is the way of life.
questions.reflectionAm: ወደ ሚመራበት ተከታዮቹ ይሄዳሉ፤ የምሳሌው መንገድ የሕይወት መንገድ ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: It is knowing Him, and eternal life begins in friendship rather than only after death.
questions.reflectionAm: እርሱን ማወቅ ነው፤ ዘላለማዊ ሕይወት የሚጀምረው ከሞት በኋላ ሳይሆን በወዳጅነት ነው።

questions.questionAm: ሞትን ትፈራለህ ወይስ በእርሱ ተስፋ አለህ?
questions.reflectionEn: Death is appointed once and then what follows, and His mercy births a living hope.
questions.reflectionAm: ሞት አንዴ የተወሰነ ነው፣ ከዚያም የሚከተለው አለ፤ ምሕረቱ ሕያው ተስፋ ያወልዳል።

questions.questionEn: Given the gift, or earning it?
questions.reflectionEn: It is given in love and received in faith, and believing has crossed into life.
questions.reflectionAm: በፍቅር ተሰጥቷል፣ በእምነት ይቀበላል፤ ያመነ ቀድሞ ወደ ሕይወት አልፏል።

questions.reflectionEn: Nothing in all creation can separate, and having the Son already means having life.
questions.reflectionAm: በፍጥረት ሁሉ የሚለይ የለም፤ ልጁን ማግኘት ሕይወትን ማግኘት ነው።

questions.reflectionEn: A wise heart counts days and stores what heaven keeps, and each moment holds eternity.
questions.reflectionAm: ጥበበኛ ልብ ቀኖችን ይቆጥራል፣ ሰማይ የሚጠብቀውን ያከማቻል፤ እያንዳንዱ ቅጽበት ዘላለምን ይይዛል።

questions.reflectionEn: Longing for the heavenly city shapes how home is lived; His kingdom is not here.
questions.reflectionAm: የሰማይ ከተማ መናፈቅ ቤትን እንዴት እንደምትኖር ይቀርጻል፤ መንግሥቱ ከዚህ ዓለም አይደለም።
